title: Pop star Madison Beer and NFL player Justin Herbert announce engagement
facts: American singer-songwriter Madison Beer and Los Angeles Chargers quarterback Justin Herbert announced their engagement on social media.
The couple shared proposal photos on Instagram with the caption 'meet my fiancé'.
Justin Herbert is 28 years old and Madison Beer is 27 years old.
Madison Beer and Justin Herbert were first seen together publicly in August 2025.
Madison Beer attended Los Angeles Chargers football games during the previous NFL season.
The couple has frequently attended Los Angeles Dodgers and Los Angeles Lakers games together.
Justin Herbert is entering his seventh NFL season as quarterback for the Los Angeles Chargers.
Justin Herbert was scheduled to report to Chargers training camp on Wednesday.
The Los Angeles Chargers congratulated the couple on social media using the message 'JH+MB 4EV'.
The National Football League issued a public message of congratulations to the couple on social platform X.
Madison Beer has received two career Grammy Award nominations.
Madison Beer achieved public prominence in 2012 at age 13 after Justin Bieber shared her cover video of Etta James' 'At Last'.
Madison Beer released her debut commercial music single in 2013 featuring a video cameo by Justin Bieber.
Justin Herbert made an appearance in Madison Beer's music video for her single 'lovergirl'.
The music video for 'lovergirl' shows Madison Beer and Justin Herbert embracing on a beach.
